name: spec-truth
body: The target-truth content of a durable spec statement: what is, or what needs to become true. A replaced statement is updated or removed, never annotated; a `note` deepens the understanding of what is and never records the past or another note — a `note` details only the non-note node or code it deepens, and the binary refuses a `Note`→`Note` `details` edge at write time. Materializing a source spec or reconciling to an implementation rewrites the nodes to the present truth and leaves no provenance trail — git history, not the spec, describes the past.
